# Grafbase

Grafbase is a platform that accelerates the development of GraphQL APIs, offering features like edge caching, unified data access, and seamless integration with popular authentication strategies.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/grafbase/.

## Actions

- **Disable MCP server**: Disable the Model Context Protocol server.
- **Enable Grafbase MCP Server**: Enable the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for a Grafbase project.
- **Get Federated Schema** (read-only): Retrieve the composed federated graph schema.
- **Get Subgraph Schema** (read-only): Retrieve the GraphQL SDL of a specific subgraph.
- **List API Keys** (read-only): List all API keys for a project.
- **List Grafbase Schemas** (read-only): List all Grafbase schemas.
- **List Grafbase Subgraphs** (read-only): List published subgraphs in a branch.
- **Delete Extension**: Delete an extension configuration.
- **Delete Grafbase API Key**: Delete an existing API key.
- **Delete Grafbase Audit Log**: Delete a specific Grafbase audit log entry.
- **Delete Grafbase Schema**: Delete a Grafbase schema.
- **Delete MCP Server**: Delete a Grafbase MCP server configuration by its unique ID.
- **Delete Schema Check**: Delete a Grafbase schema check.
- **Get Grafbase Audit Log** (read-only): Retrieve a specific Grafbase audit log entry.
- **Get Grafbase Schema Check** (read-only): Retrieve the result of a schema check by its ID.
- **List Extensions** (read-only): List all extensions configured for a Grafbase project.
- **List Grafbase Audit Logs** (read-only): List all audit logs for a project.
- **List Grafbase Schema Checks** (read-only): List all Grafbase schema checks for a project.
- **List MCP Servers** (read-only): List all MCP servers configured for a project.
